title: Law to require “look up” pedestrian safety markings at crosswalks
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to paint pedestrian safety markings, such as “LOOK UP” or “LOOK BOTH WAYS,” at street corners near crosswalks within one year of enactment. It requires markings at no fewer than 500 intersections citywide, including at least 50 per borough and 200 near schools, with inspections every five years. The bill also requires the department to distribute street safety educational materials to schools.
